# osys.one — deployment

<!-- osys-one-portfolio · maintained by the opencode agent session · do not edit from other sessions -->

The site is a **static tree with no build step**. What is generated is only
`assets/manifest.json`, which carries the measured numbers the page displays.

```
index.html                 the page
assets/css/site.css        stylesheet
assets/js/site.js          metrics injection, the hero field, nav
assets/manifest.json       measured figures (regenerated by build/manifest.py)
assets/fonts/              self-hosted Archivo + IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL)
build/manifest.py          measures the source trees → manifest.json
build/verify.py            links, anchors, assets, accessible names
build/shoot.py             headless screenshots
serve.py                   local dev server
deploy/                    this directory
```

## Local first

```bash
cd ~/portfolio-osys-one
python3 serve.py            # http://127.0.0.1:8080/
```

Or as a persistent service on the host:

```bash
cp deploy/portfolio.service ~/.config/systemd/user/
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now portfolio.service
```

`deploy/serve.py` is the production server: gzip, ETag/304, CSP, correct
MIME types, no directory listing. It binds to loopback by default.

## Publishing

The site is served by **GitHub Pages** from the `oskamart/portfolio` repository,
with `CNAME` = `osys.one`. Publishing is one command:

```bash
deploy/publish.sh
```

It regenerates the manifest, verifies the site against a temporary server,
commits, pushes, and then checks the live URL.

## The domain

`osys.one` is registered at GoDaddy. It currently resolves to two AWS Global
Accelerator addresses that front a redirect service pointing at
`osys.duckdns.org`, whose origin (`80.216.179.112`) does not answer from the
public internet.

For GitHub Pages to serve `osys.one`, the registrar has to publish:

| Name | Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `osys.one` | A | `185.199.108.153` |
| `osys.one` | A | `185.199.109.153` |
| `osys.one` | A | `185.199.110.153` |
| `osys.one` | A | `185.199.111.153` |
| `www.osys.one` | CNAME | `oskamart.github.io` |

The MX records for Proton Mail stay as they are — mail is unaffected.

GitHub issues the certificate for `osys.one` on its own once the records
resolve; there is nothing to renew by hand. Verify with:

```bash
python3 deploy/check_domain.py
```

## If a different host is preferred

The site is plain static files. Any of these work:

- **nginx** — `root /home/o/portfolio; index index.html;`
- **Caddy** — `osys.one { root * /home/o/portfolio }` (TLS automatic)
- **Apache** — a `DocumentRoot /home/o/portfolio` vhost
- **GitHub Pages** — as above

For anything but GitHub Pages, terminate TLS with a real certificate
(Certbot, or Caddy's built-in ACME) and serve `index.html` for `/`.
